character_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE isolated full-body STATIC PNG desktop-pet state of Ludens, matching the attached APPROVED reference very closely. It is one independent state, NOT an animation, NOT a sprite sheet, NOT a collage. Keep the same clean thick-black-outline chibi drawing, broad flat-chinned head, miniature body about two heads tall, white long hair with pale lavender cel shadows, muted red eyes, tiny mouth, short little limbs. Same character identity and restrained silly personality. No elaborate painterly rendering, no realistic anatomy.

LOCKED DESIGN: silver-white long loose hair and one curved ahoge; black spider-shaped hairclip with EXACTLY THREE red beads on HER LEFT temple (viewer RIGHT in frontal pose); tiny black choker with a red bead; simple black athletic crop tank; black sports shorts with off-white hem, small red accents and drawstring; tiny bare feet. Two human arms and two human legs, and EXACTLY FOUR additional black articulated spider appendages with red inner strips, TWO PER SIDE. FOUR spider appendages clearly GROW FROM HER BACK, two upper and two lower root segments continuously connected behind the ribcage. The roots must be visible beside the torso. Rear hair falls between/behind their roots, not across the entire connection. Never make the appendages float, grow from hair, or sprout from the head. No antennae, no extra appendages. Ordinary mode has NO additional forehead eyes, unless the specific state explicitly requires battle mode.

ASSET FORMAT: genuinely transparent background, square 1280x1280 canvas, no checkerboard, no scenery, no ground shadow, no decorative sparkles/icons or lettering. ONE complete character, no cropping. Keep standing-state head scale and silhouette close to reference, full figure centered about x=640, baseline for feet/resting support near y=1180, modest clear margin. For seated/crouched/sleeping poses, preserve the SAME head diameter rather than enlarging the shorter figure to fill the canvas. Keep all hair and appendage tips inside the canvas. Small-size readability is essential. Expressions are drawn into the character, no caption.
SPECIFIC STATE:

states.label: 默认站立
states.description: Use the approved reference unchanged.

states.label: 蛛肢托坐
states.description: She sits on a compact seat made by folding the LOWER PAIR of her own spider appendages under her hips, feet dangling close together, tiny hands resting on her knees, calm half-lidded face. Upper pair stays relaxed outward, all four appendages visibly trace to the back. No chair, stool, or other furniture.

states.label: 四处张望
states.description: Standing, head turned slightly toward viewer LEFT with curious sideways red eyes, one tiny hand shading above her eyes like a scout, other hand relaxed. Upper spider pair slightly open as if listening. Preserve flat chibi face, not exaggerated excitement.

states.label: 犯困
states.description: Standing slightly slumped, eyelids nearly closed and tiny mouth yawning, one mitten hand rubbing one eye. Spider appendages droop gently but keep all four separate; ahoge slightly flopped. No sleep text or bubbles.

states.label: 睡觉
states.description: A compact curled-up sleeping pose on the ground, knees tucked toward the side, cheek on her two little hands, eyes closed in simple curved lines and peaceful mouth. Long hair pools in a compact shape under/behind her, four back-attached spider appendages fold protectively around the sides, each countable. No bed, pillow, furniture, or Zzz. Same head scale as reference, with more transparent space above.

states.label: 观察
states.description: Standing leaning forward a little with concentrated half-lidded eyes and one hand above her eyes, the other human hand on her hip; upper spider pair gently fanned outward, lower pair planted for balance. Convey focused examination, distinct from casual looking around. No magnifying glass, text, or effects.

states.label: 思考
states.description: Standing, one human mitten hand under her chin, other arm folded across belly, half-lidded eyes looking upward-left, tiny pursed mouth. One upper spider tip curls slightly toward the side of her head without touching it; all four remain clearly back-attached. Quiet thoughtful face.

states.label: 操作
states.description: Standing or perched with both human hands busy typing on a small simple charcoal open laptop held securely at waist height by the lower spider pair; the upper pair remain visible. Laptop has only one muted red small mark, no text, no UI. Focused half-lidded face, laptop does not hide her whole body or roots.

states.label: 等待
states.description: Standing with tiny arms folded, weight slightly shifted, half-lidded red eyes glancing off to one side and a small straight mouth: mildly impatient but composed. Spider appendages tucked closer to body, one lower tip lifted slightly as if about to tap. No watch, hourglass, text or effects.

states.label: 成功得意
states.description: Standing with hands on hips, tiny smug closed-mouth catlike smile and half-lidded confident eyes, chin slightly raised. Upper spider pair raised in a modest celebratory V while lower pair balances. No crown, trophy, sparkle, lettering, or extra symbols.

states.label: 失败吃瘪
states.description: Standing with puffed cheeks and a little displeased mouth, red eyes half-lidded and looking away, small hands clenched at sides, upper appendages drooping in embarrassment. Cute stubborn annoyance, not crying intensely. No tears, sweat icons, text, or scenery.

states.label: 招手
states.description: Standing in the same proportions as the reference, HER RIGHT human hand (viewer LEFT) raised in a small friendly wave, other hand down, gentle tiny smile and red eyes warmly open but still simple. Spider appendages relaxed.

states.label: 被戳惊讶
states.description: Standing recoiling a tiny amount, face slightly turned, both red eyes widened into simple ovals and mouth a tiny open circle; one small hand near cheek and the other held out. Upper spider pair spring upward in surprise. Do not draw any outside hand, finger, cursor, effect, or text.

states.label: 被摸头开心
states.description: Standing with head slightly dipped, eyes closed into happy arcs, tiny contented smile and light cheek blush, both hands tucked together in front. All four back-attached appendages loosely curled and relaxed. No outside human hand or cursor, no hearts or text.

states.label: 被拎起
states.description: Suspended upright in mid-air, head and hair slightly pulled upward by an implied invisible cursor above the head, short arms helplessly out, feet dangling together, half-lidded grumpy face with puffed cheek. Four spider limbs flail outward with all roots traceable to torso. Do NOT draw any cursor, hand, string, hook or external attachment. Keep complete silhouette within canvas.

states.label: 落地蹲坐
states.description: A compact landing-crouch pose, tiny knees bent and body squatting close to ground, little human hands forward for balance, lower pair of spider limbs braced on either side like shock absorbers, upper pair slightly out. Slightly startled then composed half-lidded face, no impact bursts or floor.

states.label: 向左移动
states.description: Static single walking posture facing toward VIEWER LEFT in a gentle THREE-QUARTER view, not pure profile. One little foot steps left, opposite hand forward; body slightly inclined left. Keep the huge head scale, four back-attached appendages distinct. Hairclip remains on HER anatomical LEFT temple and must not switch sides; because of the 3/4 view its visibility may differ. No motion blur or trails.

states.label: 向右移动
states.description: Static single walking posture facing toward VIEWER RIGHT in a gentle THREE-QUARTER view, not pure profile. One little foot steps right, opposite hand forward, body slightly inclined right. Keep same head/body proportions; four spider appendages connected to back. Hairclip remains on HER anatomical LEFT temple, never mirror the accessory to the wrong side. No blur or trails.

states.label: 从左侧探头
states.description: She peeks INTO view FROM THE LEFT edge, meaning face and eyes lean toward viewer RIGHT. Keep her entire character visible on the transparent canvas, leaning diagonally to the right with both small hands held close beside her cheek as if holding an invisible vertical edge just to her left. Body slightly tucked behind her own hair, four spider appendages folded compactly yet traceable to the back. No actual wall, panel, line or frame.

states.label: 从右侧探头
states.description: She peeks INTO view FROM THE RIGHT edge, meaning face and eyes lean toward viewer LEFT. Keep entire character visible on transparent canvas, leaning diagonally left with both tiny hands close beside her cheek as if holding an invisible vertical edge just to her right. Four spider appendages compact and attached to the back. Do not mirror the hairclip: it remains on HER LEFT temple. No wall, panel, line or frame.

states.label: 打游戏
states.description: Sitting supported by her own lower spider appendages, tiny feet dangling, both human hands gripping a simple charcoal handheld game console with red buttons, face intensely focused with half-lidded eyes angled slightly downward at the game. Upper spider appendages curl outward, all four visibly connected to back. No brand, screen text or outside furniture.

states.label: 抱蜘蛛玩偶
states.description: Standing hugging ONE small round charcoal spider plush at chest/belly height with both human hands; plush has two red button eyes and tiny round stub legs, clearly a toy separate from HER FOUR articulated back appendages. Soft contented closed-mouth smile and relaxed eyes. Maintain visible distinction between plush and own appendages.

states.label: 倒挂
states.description: Playful upside-down hanging pose: body inverted, tiny bare feet toward top, oversized head below, long silver hair flowing downward with gravity into simple locks. Four back-attached spider limbs curl above/around body, ONE upper limb hooks onto a short fine silk strand that extends vertically to the top margin. Deadpan eyes looking at viewer, tiny mischievous mouth. Keep all body/hair inside canvas, no actual ceiling or scenery.

states.label: 复眼开启
states.description: BATTLE MODE. Standing ready with one tiny human fist at hip and other hand pointing forward, four back-attached spider appendages spread assertively. In ADDITION to her TWO normal red eyes, add EXACTLY FOUR SMALL RED EXTRA EYES on forehead/fringe: two clearly separated on each side of center. Hairclip remains in place with its separate THREE red beads, do not confuse these with forehead eyes. Keep same sleepy-flat chibi face shape and simple bold style, slightly determined expression; no weapon, magic, laser, glow, or scenery.

avatar_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS AVATAR PNG of Ludens, matching the approved attached character reference. This is an avatar icon for a desktop pet: face and hair dominate the square canvas, small shoulders and top of the black athletic tank visible, NO torso below the upper chest, NO arms or legs, NO spider appendages in this close head portrait. Centered symmetrical head-and-shoulders composition, full ahoge and hairclip inside the square with comfortable transparent margin. Silver-white hair in simple large locks, pale lavender cel shadows, bold clean black outlines, broad flat-chinned chibi face, simple red eyes, tiny mouth, tiny black/red choker. Black spider hair ornament with EXACTLY THREE red beads on HER LEFT temple (viewer RIGHT). Match reference face proportions, line weight and cartoon style. Simplify hair to shoulder-length crop for this icon composition, with deliberate clean rounded bottom silhouette. Genuinely transparent background, no text, frame, scenery, circles, gradients, checkerboard or effects. Only one avatar per image, square canvas. Expression/mode:
avatars: Calm ordinary mode, half-lidded deadpan burgundy red eyes, tiny straight mouth, exactly TWO ordinary face eyes and NO extra forehead eyes.
Happy ordinary mode, both eyes closed into relaxed upward arcs, small cheerful smiling mouth and light blush. NO extra forehead eyes. Preserve same face silhouette and clip.

Determined BATTLE mode. Keep TWO normal red face eyes with straight upper lids. ADD EXACTLY FOUR extra small red almond-shaped eyes in the white forehead/fringe area, grouped as TWO ON LEFT and TWO ON RIGHT of center, all four clearly distinct. The forehead four eyes are completely separate from the HAIRCLIP's THREE red beads. Seven small red marks altogether: four forehead eyes + three hairclip beads. Tiny serious mouth. No glowing aura or effects.
effects: Native vector drawings supplied as SVG sources and transparent PNG renders.
